description: Turn any form you already have into a working Salesforce form, and build interfaces, Experience Cloud sites and advanced Flow screens with Flow Tool Kit.

formassembly_access_token.title: FormAssembly access token
formassembly_access_token.description: Optional. Only for reading forms from your own FormAssembly account through its API (form-migrate and formassembly-capture). Sent only to FormAssembly. Leave blank to work from exports or a public form link.
